messages:
Liam (Sales): heads-up from a few customers: they want clear guarantees when region failovers happen. they want a predictable ranking for their traffic, not fuzzy best-effort.
Megan (PM): noted. we need a product playbook that ties priority bands to docs, billing labels, and migration windows. MVP should be conservative and reversible.
Dmitri (Infra): design idea: introduce 'grace windows' + 'burst pools'. grace window = short soft-failover period (30s) before hard eviction; burst pools = reserve capacity for gold-band traffic.
Hector (SRE): grace windows are good for avoiding oscillation, but we must expose eviction signals to customers and ops. otherwise they get surprised when we drop traffic.
Ana (Privacy): regulatory constraints: some tenants are 'non-fallback' — policy must include a strict tag that disables cross-region fallback. this affects capacity planning.
Vera (Product): launch criteria proposal: (A) policy DSL v1 + customer contract template, (B) billing tag pass-through, (C) observable eviction traces + customer alerting, (D) 2-week canary with 3 customers across Dedicated and Hosted.
Liam (Sales): 3 customers is doable; will propose one enterprise (non-fallback), one scale-up (gold) and one mid-market (silver) for testing.
Dmitri (Infra): perf note: we prefer doing decision-making as a fast lookup at edge. we can keep affinity state with Redis clusters and use TTLs for grace windows. expected overhead small but requires ops automation for eviction jobs.
Hector (SRE): ops checklist: runbook for forced-evict, dashboards for per-band dropped-requests, and retention of retry traces for 48h. add simulated region ejection test to chaos suite (10m).
Megan (PM): prioritization: Q3 for internal beta, Q4 for public GA. scope for Q3: DSL, core edge lookup, affinity TTLs, telemetry + runbook. scope for Q4: quota-to-billing integration, automated rebalancer, per-tenant SLAs.
Ana (Privacy): make sure the DSL includes explicit 'no-fallback' and 'data-residency' clauses. legal will need the contract template before canary.
Vera (Product): UX: customers need a clear matrix: what happens to requests for each band during partial outage (e.g., <30s, 30-300s, >300s). produce a concise doc.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-18002 "grace-windows + burst-pools design" and linked runbook template.
Dmitri (Infra): action items: infra sizing for burst pools, eviction automation POC (EOD Thu).
Hector (SRE): action items: draft runbook + chaos test plan (Tue).
Ana (Privacy): action items: contract draft + mandatory tags list (Wed).
Vera (Product): action items: customer matrix + docs skeleton (Fri).
Megan (PM): I'll coordinate canary customers with Liam and sales. we'll reconvene after RFCs land. keep replies short in-thread. :ok_hand:
